facts.text: Cold drink, hot fritters and no talk about Crab Key, Cap'n. That island is bad luck for fishermen.
facts.why: Quarrel never says this. The summary page quotes his real lines about Crab Key, and the sentence about it being bad luck is not among them.
facts.fix: All except Crab Key. We didn't have no right to go there.

fix_note.text: All except Crab Key. We didn't have no right to go there.

facts.text: Quarrel's round, before the boat goes out.
facts.why: At the bar Quarrel and Puss Feller jump Bond, then Felix explains they are on his side. Nobody buys a round or names a lager.
facts.fix: Bond's cold one, once the scuffle is over.

vibe.verdict: Puss Feller's is a real stop in the film and the tab and the gold on black look suit the 1962 Jamaica setting.
